# PUT /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/notifications

Mark notification threads as read, pinned or unread on a specific repo

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-023`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| all | query | string | False |
| status-types | query | array[string] | False |
| to-status | query | string | False |
| last_read_at | query | string | False |

## Response

**205** — []*NotificationThread

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | notification thread ID |
| `repository` | Repository | associated repository |
| `subject` | NotificationSubject | notification subject details |
| `unread` | bool | whether notification is unread |
| `pinned` | bool | whether notification is pinned |
| `updated_at` | time.Time | last update time |
| `url` | string | API URL for this thread |

- **400** — Invalid last_read_at format (not RFC 3339)
- **500** — Database error during find or status update

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Default status filter for read operations is 'unread' only | business_logic | !ctx.FormBool("all") && len(statuses) == 0 |
| Default target status for mark-as-read is 'read' | business_logic | targetStatus == 0 (invalid or empty to-status param) |
| last_read_at must be valid RFC 3339 format if provided | validation | len(qLastRead) > 0 && time.Parse fails |
| SetNotificationStatus verifies user ownership before updating | authorization | notification.UserID != user.ID |
| Notification convert suppresses repo info if user lost access | business_logic | !perm.HasAnyUnitAccessOrPublicAccess() |

Total: ~8 DB round-trips per notification. | Use batch UPDATE query, then batch-load attributes using NotificationList.LoadAttributes pattern |
